title: adaptive-prefetch-throttle-and-quant-ramp-autotune
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Prefetch/prefix prefill is a major contributor to wasted token compute for spiky workloads; naive prefetching inflates unit cost when load has poor locality. At the same time, aggressive static quant profiles risk quality regressions for tail requests. This PR implements two coordinated automations: (1) an adaptive prefetch throttle that learns per-model/per-route prefill hit-rate and dynamically reduces prefill aggressiveness for low-locality workloads, and (2) a quantization ramp controller that gradually applies lower-precision profiles during sustained low-sensitivity windows and backs off when eval metrics degrade. Design summary: the prefetch throttle collects a lightweight rolling window of prefix-hit ratios and request inter-arrival statistics, computes an expected prefill ROI score, and adjusts prefill budget (requests per second allowed to prefetch) using a PID-lite controller. The quant ramper registers with the Optimize subsystem and uses production eval hooks to compute a short-term quality delta (bleu/rouge-based or embedding cos-sim proxies) before committing to a lower quant profile; it supports staged ramps (full -> q8 -> q4) with configurable hold periods and rollback triggers. Config/ops: new org-level config keys: econ.prefetch.throttle.enabled (bool, default=false for safety), econ.prefetch.throttle.window_s (int), econ.prefetch.throttle.target_roi (float), econ.quant.ramp.enabled (bool, default=false), econ.quant.ramp.stages (ordered list), econ.quant.ramp.min_hold_s (int). Rollout plan: start off by enabling both features as "opt-in shadow" in Dedicated and Hosted canaries, collect telemetry for 48h, then enable soft-enforcement in a small percentage (5%) of traffic for 7 days, finally flip default off->on for selected perf-sensitive models after product signoff. Tests & telemetry: end-to-end integration tests simulate low- and high-locality traffic to assert throttle converges and prefill budgets fall back to baseline; quant ramp simulated on eval harness with synthetic regressions to verify rollback. Telemetry: added prefill.hits, prefill.misses, prefill.budget_used, quant.ramp.stage, quant.ramp.rollback_count, econ.unit_cost_delta. Benchmarks: internal staging run across three representative workloads shows median unit cost improvement 12% on spiky workloads with <1% quality delta (measured by embedding-sim proxy). Implementation notes: new controllers implemented in serving/runtime/prefill and optimize/ramp; lightweight in-memory stores with optional persistence to kv for operator visibility; new CLI flags and API surface for manual override. Documentation: README updates in docs/econ and examples in redwood-quickstarts showing config snippets and how to revert. Related work: complements ongoing batch/caching heuristics (see ENG-1987) and reuses the cost-scorer from pr-331210. Checklist: - [x] Design doc (linked in linear ENG-2245) - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Telemetry + dashboards - [x] API + CLI controls - [x] Docs + quickstart example - [x] Canary deployment notes

merge_commit_message:
squash: adaptive prefetch throttle + quant ramp controller

Implements dynamic prefill budgeting and staged quantization ramps with rollback triggers. Adds telemetry, tests, docs, and config defaults.
operational_notes: Default is disabled. To enable in a controlled rollout: 1) set econ.prefetch.throttle.enabled=true in the org config for the canary org, 2) enable econ.quant.ramp.enabled=true in Optimize for the test models, 3) monitor dashboard 'prefill-quant' for regressions. Emergency rollback: set both flags to false or use CLI econ disable-ramp/disable-prefetch. Alerts tuned to fire on quant.ramp.rollback_count > 3 in 5m.
notes_for_release_engineer: This change touches serving/runtime and Optimize. Ensure canaries are scheduled on non-production pools first. No DB migrations. Telemetry index added for prefill.* metrics; ensure observability retains at least 7 days for initial rollout.
follow_up_tasks: ENG-3021: expose per-route prefetch ROI tuning UI in Console
ENG-3032: add regression evaluation suite that uses customer prompt suites for quant ramp validation
ENG-3040: explore persistence of throttle state across restarts for Dedicated
